items.title: U.S. stock futures tick higher after Wall St slips on hot CPI, Nvidia losses
items.summary: Investing.com-- U.S. stock futures edged higher on Tuesday evening after Wall Street ended modestly lower, as hotter-than-expected inflation data reinforced expectations of another Federal Reserve rate hike, while weakness in Nvidia weighed on technology shares.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures Rise, CoreWave Jumps After Stocks Fall On Nvidia, Surging Treasury Yields
